headline: Foseco Crucible closes trading window ahead of Q2 results
hook: Trading window shut for Foseco insiders
summary: Foseco Crucible has closed its trading window for designated persons and their immediate relatives. This action is a standard regulatory requirement ahead of the company's board meeting to approve its Q2FY27 financial results. The window will remain closed until 48 hours after the declaration of the quarterly earnings. Trading by insiders is prohibited during this period to prevent potential misuse of unpublished price-sensitive information.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance procedure with no impact on retail investors.
